{"story":{"what":"The change adds a GeneratedMessagePackFormatterAttribute (with an optional SurrogateType) to MessagePack.Annotations. The source generator finds partial classes that carry this attribute. A new GeneratedFormatterCollector builds an ObjectSerializationInfo for the T in each class's IMessagePackFormatter<T>, either in contractless mode (public read-write members keyed by name) or from a surrogate's [Key]/[IgnoreMember] annotations. The formatter templates then write the body into the user's partial class, which the generated resolver registers.
